title: instance.json
description: Org/Odoo coupling + legal entity (plan §2.2). Ops-owned. Connector-agnostic: impl_template_id and odoo_partner_manager are DISCOVERED/verified per connected DB, not hardcoded across entities. legal_entity is required (each Dynapps entity is a distinct legal seller). Fields tagged verify_from_odoo must be confirmed against the connected instance, never inherited from es.

odoo_db.description: Odoo DB name, e.g. 'master'. Also a resolve_locale signal.

impl_template_name.description: Name of the sale.order.template ('Implantación v2'). The engine RESOLVES its id at runtime by name in the connected DB — do NOT hardcode 15; it differs per DB.

impl_template_id.description: OPTIONAL cached id for the impl template in THIS DB (es historical=15). null = resolve by name at runtime (preferred). Never share across entities.

cases_base_url.description: Base URL de los casos de éxito por locale (case studies).

_cases_base_url_note.description: Nota interna sobre cases_base_url (campo comentario, prefijo _).

industries.description: OPTIONAL. EXACT industry taxonomy labels of this entity's market website, keyed by the canonical industry ids of shared/industries.json. Value = label string (flat language packs: es/en) OR a {lang: label} object (country layers composed with multiple languages: BE nl/fr, CH fr/en). Only include ids the country site actually offers (BE has no construction; CH has no laboratories/logistics). Reference cards must render the label verbatim — never translate or paraphrase (Ine/marketing rule).

_industries_note.description: Nota interna sobre industries (campo comentario, prefijo _).

team_email_domain.description: Domain for hr.employee team lookup, e.g. 'dynapps.es'.

core_module_label.description: Display label of the entity's Core module set, e.g. 'Dynapps Core'.

core_module_set_exists.description: Whether an Dynapps-Core-equivalent module set exists for this entity.

name.description: Registered legal name of the selling entity, e.g. 'DYNAPPS BUSINESS SOLUTIONS, S.L.'.

offices.description: Office/country list phrasing shown in 'why us'.

claims_text.description: Per-locale free text REVIEWED for local advertising law (FR DGCCRF / NL misleidende reclame). Not a reused boolean. es='Partner de Odoo a nivel mundial'.

experts.description: Group expert headcount for the credibility band, e.g. 280 (Ine sales deck). Group-level figure: same value in every layer.

countries.description: Countries with active customers for the credibility band, e.g. 52 (Ine sales deck). Group-level figure: same value in every layer.

iso27001.description: true SOLO donde la entidad tiene la certificación ISO 27001 (BE); false => claim genérica de seguridad
